svg.text: PG-1 wiring 7/10: The ground chain (black wire, part to part)
One black wire from each lug to the next, in step order. The last one (from the screen's GND) is SPLICED onto the jumper that runs from the
board's 'gnd' to Seed3 place 40, about 3 cm from the socket: strip 5 mm, wrap, solder, heat shrink (a socket place only holds one jumper
Seed3 socket: the jumper-end block in the right wall, from INSIDE (USB-C end on your left)
Steps (the number is on the wire)
pg-1 encoder: MIDDLE pin of the row of 3 (C) -> pg-1
pg-1 encoder: RIGHT pin of the 2 (push 2) -> pg-2
encoder: MIDDLE pin of the row of 3 (C)
pg-2 encoder: MIDDLE pin of the row of 3 (C) -> pg-2
pg-2 encoder: RIGHT pin of the 2 (push 2) -> pg-3
encoder: MIDDLE pin of the row of 3 (C)
pg-3 encoder: MIDDLE pin of the row of 3 (C) -> pg-3
pg-3 encoder: RIGHT pin of the 2 (push 2) -> pg-4
encoder: MIDDLE pin of the row of 3 (C)
pg-4 encoder: MIDDLE pin of the row of 3 (C) -> pg-4
pg-4 encoder: RIGHT pin of the 2 (push 2) -> pg-a
pg-a footswitch: the other lug -> pg-b footswitch:
pg-b footswitch: the other lug -> pg-c footswitch:
pg-c footswitch: the other lug -> screen: the pin
ground chain (screen GND: cut a jumper, solder its cut
screen: the pin printed 'GND' (pin 2) -> Seed3 socket
chain's end: SPLICED onto the j10.gnd -> seed.40
jumper, 3 cm from the socket (strip 5 mm, wrap, solder,
heat shrink). A socket place holds one jumper only
